error_timing_analysis.note: ALL errors occurred in the final 2.25 hours of the session. The first 3.25 hours (9:30-12:44 ET) had ZERO errors.

candidate_activity_during_error_window.reason: By 12:37 ET, the regime had already flipped back to trending_up (incorrect). The 'Entries blocked' state was active for most post-12:00 ticks due to the backing-off scheduler. Even without errors, zero candidates would have passed.
candidate_activity_during_error_window.conclusion: Errors were INCIDENTAL to the zero-trade outcome, not causal

recovery_behavior.note: Every error had streak=1 — the scheduler recovered on the very next tick. No persistent degradation.

root_cause_of_disconnects.error: RemoteDisconnected('Remote end closed connection without response')
root_cause_of_disconnects.explanation: Alpaca paper API drops idle HTTP connections. The SDK reuses connections without keepalive. After market close, Alpaca may be more aggressive about closing idle connections.
root_cause_of_disconnects.frequency: ~1 disconnect every 15 minutes in the post-close period

websocket_behavior.impact: Stale data warnings during reconnection, then normal operation

recommendation.fix: Add retry with backoff in positions_service.get_all_positions() (3 attempts, 1s/2s/4s delay)
recommendation.urgency: Not needed for tomorrow. Errors occur post-close and self-recover. Would be nice-to-have for cleaner logs.
